keys: Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR

Amazon.Flags on the definition: hidden: Boolean (“whether a property should be hidden in Amazon user interfaces”) · editable: Boolean · enumNames (display labels) — Purpose: Informational; observed editable:false, hidden:true on child_relationship_type, marketplace_id. First-party 2026-09-21.
Amazon.Per category: by product type — the property groups differ per type; requiredness is on the (type, attribute) join.
Amazon.Per channel: a per-marketplace selector on every value: "selectors": ["marketplace_id", "language_tag"]; status per marketplace.
Amazon.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: per property group — product_details: “to support search, browse and detail page content (e.g., bullets, product features, model, style name)”; safety_and_compliance: compliance, hazmat, legal warnings; 267,595 release-note rows: “A new optional attribute is introduced to improve the product detail page.”
Amazon.Filters (buyer-facing): the browse-tree Refinements sheet: 2,600,729 rows / 1,407 distinct attributes (US 1,035); the search API exposes two refinement axes, brands, classifications.

Shopify.Flags on the definition: MetafieldDefinition.access: MetafieldAccess! {admin, storefront, customerAccount} · capabilities {smartCollectionCondition, adminFilterable, uniqueValues} each {eligible, enabled, status} · pinnedPosition: Int · StandardMetafieldDefinitionTemplate.visibleToStorefrontApi: Boolean!.
Shopify.Per category: conditional metafields — constraints {key: "category", values: [ids]} on a Product definition (shopify.color-pattern: 7,750 ids); taxonomy: per-category membership (live: Flavor on Snack Foods, absent on Pasta & Noodles).
Shopify.Per channel: the access triple — live {admin: PUBLIC_READ_WRITE, storefront: PUBLIC_READ, customerAccount: NONE}; the one per-channel visibility of the definition in the thirteen.
Shopify.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: “A defined metafield gets a typed editor in the admin, validation on write, and support for search and filtering.”; conditional: “Shoe size is a valid metafield for Shoes but wouldn't apply to Sweaters.”

Google.Per category: requiredness only (Required / It depends / Optional); existence in one case (subscription_cost: “approved product categories only”).
Google.Per channel: at product level: excludedDestinations (13-value enum), includedDestinations, shopping_ads_excluded_country, pause; per-surface availability by publication (lifestyle_image_link “browsy surfaces”, short_title “Demand Gen Ads”).
Google.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: “Required: … your product won't be able to serve … Optional: … help boost your product's performance.”; landing-page match: “Make sure that the product details displayed on your landing page match the variant-identifying values.”
Google.Filters (buyer-facing): n/a (a feed); custom_label_0-4 ≤1,000 unique values each, buyer visibility not answered.

eBay.Flags on the definition: 11 per aspect: aspectEnabledForVariations · aspectMode (FREE_TEXT | SELECTION_ONLY) · aspectRequired · itemToAspectCardinality (SINGLE | MULTI) · aspectUsage (OPTIONAL 136,195 | RECOMMENDED 60,851) · aspectApplicableTo (ITEM 19,206 | PRODUCT 87,560) · aspectDataType (STRING | NUMBER | DATE | STRING_ARRAY) · aspectAdvancedDataType · aspectFormat · aspectMaxLength · expectedRequiredByDate + valueConstraints.
eBay.Per category: by construction — “Each category has a different set of aspects and different requirements for aspect values.”
eBay.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: “Buyers use item specifics to filter their search results, and your item will only appear in those filtered search results if you've added the matching item specific.” (Seller Center); relevanceIndicator/searchCount gated to Buyer Demand Data apps.

Walmart.Flags on the definition: a per-slot purpose tier on 100 % of 383,947 slots: comments = "@group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website" 258,217 · Required for the item to be visible 58,595 · Recommended to create a variant experience 27,828 · Required to sell 13,781 · Condition Details 6,996. Viewing/editing restrictions exist only as workbook headers (Restrict Viewing by, Restrict Editing For).
Walmart.Per channel: a different tier vocabulary per feed type (MP_ITEM vs MP_MAINTENANCE vs MP_ITEM_MATCH); businessUnit ∈ [SAMSCLUB, WALMART_CA, WALMART_US, ASDA_GM].
Walmart.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: sell · be visible · improve search and browse · create a variant experience — the tier strings themselves.
Walmart.Filters (buyer-facing): searchable/facet/filterable/refinement 0 hits; the variant display ranking is “published nowhere”.

Shopee.Flags on the definition: attribute_info {input_type (5), input_validation_type (5), format_type (2), date_format_type, attribute_unit_list, max_value_count, is_oem, support_search_value} + mandatory; support_search_value undescribed.
Shopee.Per category: by construction — only last-level categories retrieve attributes.
Shopee.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: compliance as attribute: a blocking validation keyed to attribute_id 101351 against government open data (2026-01-23); Anvisa attribute made mandatory.

Tokopedia.Flags on the definition: none in either era. Era B: id, name, type, is_requried, values[], value_data_format, is_customizable, requirement_conditions[], is_multiple_selection — requiredness, customisability, conditional requiredness; no visibility/filter flag.
Tokopedia.Per category: by construction; “bound to the specified category, based on your shop's location.”
Tokopedia.Per channel: at product level: listing_platforms ∈ {TOKOPEDIA, TIKTOK_SHOP}; is_not_for_sale (GWP-only, hidden from search).
Tokopedia.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: “Product attributes are general attributes such as manufacturer, country of origin, materials used … Sales attributes are attributes that are specific to the variant (aka SKU) such as size, color, length.”; internal rules: EU unit price via sku_unit_count + unit-type attributes; “Imported Goods” 102254.

Square.Flags on the definition: seller_visibility (enum 2: SELLER_VISIBILITY_READ_WRITE_VALUES, SELLER_VISIBILITY_HIDDEN) · app_visibility (enum 3; APP_VISIBILITY_READ_ONLY_VALUES rejected live); per object type ITEM/ITEM_VARIATION visible in Dashboard + API, MODIFIER/MODIFIER_LIST/CATEGORY API-only.
Square.Per category: no — a definition allowed on ITEM appears on every item.
Square.Per channel: in prose: “The Square Point of Sale application doesn't show custom attributes for any object type.”
Square.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: the cap is expressed in visibility terms: “up to 10 seller-visible and 10 seller-hidden custom attributes.”
Square.Filters (buyer-facing): no per-custom-attribute flag; searchability only on built-ins (CatalogItemOption.name, sku, abbreviation).

Salesforce B2C.Flags on the definition: only @system: xsd:boolean on the attribute reference; no shown/hidden flag.
Salesforce B2C.Per category: the design: ObjectAttributeGroups attach to a category; the model = global groups + the classification category's + its ancestors' (Product.getAttributeModel()); sub-category overrides parent by id (single route).
Salesforce B2C.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: “The attribute assignments display on the product details page and during some product comparisons.”

Akeneo.Flags on the definition: useable_as_grid_filter (true on auto_exposure, color; undescribed) · sort_order · group → AttributeGroup · unique · localizable · scopable (immutable; a scopable attribute cannot be an axis) · is_locale_specific. No visible flag.
Akeneo.Per category: absent (0 hits, controls 203/62/117); the Family decides; a separate pim_catalog_category_attribute attaches attributes to the category record.
Akeneo.Per channel: first-class as requiredness: pim_catalog_attribute_requirement.required under UNIQUE (channel_id, family_id, attribute_id) — "attribute_requirements": {"ecommerce": […], "mobile": […], "print": […]}; every value {locale, scope, data}.
Akeneo.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: completeness: “which family attributes are required for the completeness calculation.”
Akeneo.Filters (buyer-facing): n/a (a PIM); the grid filter flag is staff-facing.

WooCommerce.Flags on the definition: attribute_public int(1) DEFAULT 1 → REST has_archives (lands as 0); per (product, attribute): visible → is_visible 1/0 (undescribed); attribute_orderby ∈ menu_order | name | name_num | id.
WooCommerce.Per category: absent (500 product_cat lines, 0 touch an attribute taxonomy).
WooCommerce.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: ordering: “the sorting order of the attributes affects the sorting order of the dropdown selector(s) on the product page.”
WooCommerce.Filters (buyer-facing): structural: wc_product_attributes_lookup for global attributes only (// Custom product attribute, not suitable for attribute-based filtering.), gated by woocommerce_attribute_lookup_enabled.

commercetools.Flags on the definition: isSearchable · inputHint (SingleLine | MultiLine) · inputTip? · label · isRequired · attributeConstraint · level (Product | Variant); nested/set types not searchable; product-level not supported by the (deprecated) Product Projection Search.
commercetools.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: a per-request selection on a PDP read model: “Variant-level Attribute names to include in the response … Product-level Attributes are silently omitted.”

Magento.Flags on the definition: catalog_eav_attribute, 24 columns: is_global (default 1) · is_visible (default 1) · is_searchable · is_filterable (enum: 0 No · 1 Filterable with results · 2 Filterable no results) · is_comparable · is_visible_on_front · is_html_allowed_on_front · is_used_for_price_rules · is_filterable_in_search · used_in_product_listing · used_for_sort_by · apply_to · is_visible_in_advanced_search · position · is_wysiwyg_enabled · is_used_for_promo_rules · is_required_in_admin_store · is_used_in_grid · is_visible_in_grid · is_filterable_in_grid · frontend_input_renderer · search_weight float default 1 · additional_data text.
Magento.Per category: absent over 352 <table> blocks; the attribute set gates data entry — “determines the fields that are available during data entry, and the values that appear to the customer.”
Magento.Per channel: value scope: SCOPE_STORE=0 · SCOPE_GLOBAL=1 · SCOPE_WEBSITE=2; values UNIQUE (entity_id, attribute_id, store_id); option labels per store view.
Magento.Stated purpose / what attributes are FOR: one flag per use — storefront, listing, sort, search, layered navigation, compare, promo rules, price rules, admin grid.
Magento.Filters (buyer-facing): layered navigation via is_filterable / is_filterable_in_search — “Can be used only with catalog input type Yes/No, Dropdown, Multiple Select and Price.”
